note: Witnesses for the live signed public root — existence/time of these exact bytes. Not certification, not endorsement, not a rank sale. Never mint a token. ONE root anchor, never N leaves.

corpus_scope.note: The 317 public-root leaves and 335 separately indexed signed cards are separate corpora with 0 identifier overlap. This root and its OTS proof do not anchor the signed-card index.

signature.preimage_canonical: JSON sorted keys, separators (',',':'), ensure_ascii=false, UTF-8

rekor.type: rekord/x509 over the preimage bytes with the board signature

ots.note: Status is derived from the proof bytes. Pending is not a Bitcoin timestamp.

eas_base.reason: no EAS attestation in the append-only log matches this root.json sha256

xrpl_memo.reason: needs a funded XRPL account (owner); one memo tx carrying sha256(root.json)

conflict.rule: equal as_of + unequal merkle_root among this publisher's witnessed roots = CONFLICT; a reader must treat neither as current
conflict.limit: sees only roots this publisher witnessed and kept; independent witnesses cover the hidden-root case
